name: Minase Anko
source:
Kohane's best friend. She is the main character's love rival(?) and classmate.

She is cheerful and comical. Her character is delicious.

She deeply cares about Kohane. When the protagonist tries to get close to her, she interferes. However, she knows what she should do and what not to do. Actually sometimes she does, and sometimes she doesn't.
 
Online, she nags the protagonist and is a good leader.

Nickname Online: SUNDOME.

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/online/character/other.htm#maako]official site[/url]]
